fields.supplierId: existing organisation-scoped SRM supplier ID; not report/snapshot ID
fields.entity: SUPPLIER or verified RELATED_LEGAL_ENTITY; country/KRS/NIP/REGON as corroborated source identity
fields.label: bounded user or admitted company text; never executable markup
fields.address: structured postal data plus original source text; immutable source provenance; address may be null for an unlocated related entity
fields.addressFingerprint: SHA256 of versioned normalized address; not identity or a permission
fields.sourceIdentity: provider/model/stable record/entity/branch ID; null where unverified
fields.sourceSnapshot: source report ID, version/digest, retrievedAt, effectiveAt, completeness
fields.relationship: private source snapshot, type, start/end, validity and retention; null outside RELATED_ENTITIES
fields.provenance: separate relationship and address sources; creator/editor are separate
fields.geocodingEvidence: provider, addressVersion, fetchedAt, expiresAt, placeId, position only while permitted; server credential absent
fields.retentionUntil: earliest applicable source/data-policy expiry; manual input follows organisation retention policy
fields.auditRef: protected decision/intent/outcome reference without raw private payload

identity.manualIdentity: server locationId with actor/org/supplier-scoped idempotency key
identity.missingStableSourceId: PENDING_RECONCILIATION; stable observation within same snapshot only, no inferred cross-version merge
identity.relatedEntityMatch: country plus verified KRS; NIP checksum plus unique corroborating corporate record if no KRS; REGON secondary; name-only and sole-proprietor/person matches never admit marker

providerFields.evidence: official Get Records public sample plus current mapper and synthetic mapper regression; not a new live customer request
providerFields.confidence: VERIFIED_STRUCTURAL_MAPPING; source freshness/completeness and geographic accuracy are separate
providerFields.legalUse: Account licence/reuse entitlement not inferred from public example; admitted corporate projection only

providerFields.fallback: UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE; do not infer an empty current branch set or publish guessed markers

providerFields.evidence: current mapper and synthetic response; apps/vercly declares unknown[]; address capability and live provider payload not confirmed

providerFields.fallback: do not reuse Body.Entity address for every related entity

providerFields.evidence: address capability verified; availability for each private related entity and contract entitlement not verified

operations.permission: explicit read for collection; plus supplier.private.read for current KYS input when related group is requested
operations.idempotency: read current authorised projection; cache private/no-store
operations.audit: SECURITY_REQUIRED INTENT/OUTCOME; minimal IDs, versions and result

operations.permission: explicit write, resource scope; create/update/deactivate MANUAL only; read rights required for returned resource
operations.idempotency: actor/org/supplier/operation/key plus payload digest; expectedVersion; conflict409
operations.audit: SECURITY_REQUIRED atomic write and protected OUTCOME

operations.actor: HUMAN admission; SERVICE executes via bounded existing job.execute delegation
operations.permission: explicit sync; exact authorised accepted report inputs; KYS private.read when applicable
operations.usage: local source reuse only; no new MGBI/Vercly/Google call
operations.idempotency: org/supplier/source-kind/source-snapshot/projector-version; durable work fence and expected collection version
operations.audit: SECURITY_REQUIRED accepted request plus actual service and initiating subjectUserId

operations.actor: HUMAN admission; SERVICE via bounded job.execute plus existing Source transport authority
operations.permission: explicit geocode and read exact location/addressVersion; related input current private.read; no write via browser key
operations.usage: finite owner-approved organisation and provider caps; atomic reservation before possible upstream attempt; default0
operations.idempotency: org/location/addressVersion/provider/policy-version; one in-flight attempt; uncertain delivery never blindly retried
operations.audit: SECURITY_REQUIRED reserve/attempt/settle and outcome; provider error bodies/key/address omitted

access.embedded: host authorised projection; existing generic read channel only; commands require separate explicit host/channel adoption

lifecycle.action: admit exact source snapshot then idempotent sync; preserve unresolved postal records; geocode only with separate admitted budget
authorised stored read; no source acquisition/sync duplication; SDK lazy until explicit map action
compare authoritative source version; update source-owned rows; preserve manual rows; same version/digest no-op
CONFLICT/PENDING_RECONCILIATION; retrieval time alone does not prove source supersession
keep last known source evidence with stale status; do not interpret omissions as closure
mark inactive/superseded with source evidence; exclude current markers; keep only retention-permitted history
write own organisation manual record with expectedVersion; preserve provenance and unrelated records
stop related-entity projection immediately; purge expired private address relationship derivatives; retain minimal allowed audit
delete expired cached coordinates; keep lawful business address; expose unresolved/expired pending separately authorised resolution

geocodingPolicy.mapLoadBilling: Dynamic Maps loads can be separately billed; reopening report does not mount/load SDK automatically
geocodingPolicy.otherPrecision: LOW_PRECISION with no automatic marker; postal record preserved; Google precision inspected transiently only

consumerAcceptance: two users same organisation share records without creator filter
same supplier in second organisation cannot read first organisation manual points or KYS relations
one user switching organisations cannot retain previous map state
revocation between request/worker/read denies or withholds result
source reload/retry/concurrent sync does not duplicate records/orders
source failure and missing fields preserve manual and last known source evidence
entity name-only/person/ambiguous match produces no marker
ordinary database role RLS plus API/export/cache/background tests
actual Google/provider/UAT evidence stays separate from synthetic tests

geocodingTransport.executor: existing Maps Runtime server; generic SERVICE executor; no business-row access or separate human login
geocodingTransport.authentication: producer-approved existing E1 service identity and current bounded delegation; no local token verifier or browser credential
geocodingTransport.authorization: jobRef resolves an unexpired grant for exact caller/executor/environment/organisation/location/addressVersion/address digest and bounded provider budget; recheck initiator authority; no authority from request IDs alone
geocodingTransport.persistence: SRM applies result only after current access/source checks and matching addressVersion; Maps Runtime never connects to the SRM business schema
geocodingTransport.failure: DENY before external effect when unsupported; retain uncertain delivery fence and settle audit; no fallback to public Google or local app-private import

observedDevelopment.inferenceLimit: Zero visible rows without admitted context does not mean data is absent. No owner role, tenant impersonation, customer payload or paid provider call used.
